_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Denial is beginning to give way to early optimism, moving one rung up to Disbelief.
next_move.brains_agree: No – analyst forecasts Optimism, narrative silent on forward move
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC price breaks above $85k with VIX remaining below 16 and sentiment staying elevated
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC price falls below $80k or VIX spikes above 25, indicating a shift back toward Panic/Anxiety
